title: Targeted Image Data Augmentation Increases Basic Skills Captioning Robustness

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual data augmentation using text-to-image generation to swap gendered words (e.g., "man" to "woman") in captions and generate corresponding new images, followed by evaluating the precision, recall, and F1-score of the model's ability to correctly use gender-related words in image captioning without defaulting to biased or incorrect predictions.
